## Process

1. Apply only the selected process and approved tailoring.
2. Distinguish facts, assumptions, recommendations, and proposed decisions.
3. Follow the Artifact Need Gate treatment. Use existing carriers for `Use as-is`, draft only required changes for `Update`, and create a minimum viable draft only for `Create`.
4. For `Combine`, name the source carriers and target source of truth. For `Create later`, record the activation trigger. For `Generate on demand`, name source records and the human validation point. Create no maintained output for `Not needed`.
5. Include source traceability, unresolved gaps, owner as `TBD` when unknown, and next trigger.
6. Keep all changes under the run folder. Do not write canonical project records.

## Validation

| Check | Pass condition |
|---|---|
| Process fit | Draft addresses the selected process purpose |
| Evidence | Claims link to the evidence package |
| Completeness | Required fields from the domain recipe are present |
| Treatment fit | Draft output matches the approved need and treatment for each candidate |
| Uncertainty | Gaps and assumptions are not hidden |
| Authority | No canonical record or PM-only state was changed |
